items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Because I was in his trio for three, a couple, two, three years.

ctx.x: What’s it like working with Ruby?

The best. Yeah. I miss him. Because I was in his trio for three, a couple, two, three years. We rehearsed the first time up at my house in Croton-on-Hudson. And Howard brought Ruby up. And Ruby and I had never played together. And we were in my old study. And Howard’s [scats] swinging like mad. Ruby’s playing and Ruby’s making, he’s going [scats] and I knew immediately that he was digging it. And that trio was so good. We were so together there for a while. We made some nice records and did some good gigs and…
Great to hear that about him.
